parts.text: $MKSI Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B (+43% Y/Y), operating margin 23.1%, net earnings $236M. Semiconductor was the largest line at 45% of revenue. Analysis: $MKSI Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, operating margin 23.1%, net earnings $236M. How do you read it? #earnings #industrials

$CPAY Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.4B, +18% Y/Y, driven by Corporate Payments organic growth of 18% in spend management and cross-border. Operating margin 45.0%; net earnings $378M. Guides Q4 revenue to ~$1.37B. #earnings #industrials
$BCO Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +3% Y/Y, driven by organic growth in ATM managed services and digital retail solutions. Operating margin 9.5%; operating cash flow $90M. #earnings #industrials
$VAC Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +8% Y/Y, led by higher vacation ownership product sales. Operating cash flow reached $128M. #earnings #realestate
$TKO Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +22% Y/Y, driven by live events and sports entertainment properties. Operating margin reached 27.8%, with operating cash flow at $472M. #earnings #media

$HST Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.3B, +1% Y/Y, driven by comparable hotel RevPAR growth of 8.8% on strong transient and group demand. Operating margin 9.0%; net earnings $70M. Guides full-year comparable RevPAR growth to 6.75%. #earnings #REITs

$TKR Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +5% Y/Y, driven by higher end-market demand in Industrial Motion, favorable pricing, and acquisitions. Operating margin expanded to 13.7% aided by tariff refunds; operating cash flow reached $256M. #earnings #industrials
$ARCB Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +16% Y/Y, driven by improved market rates and higher shipment levels in Asset-Light. Operating margin 6.1% as restructuring actions progress. #earnings #industrials
$DDOG Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +35% Y/Y, driven by increased usage growth from existing customers and expanding product adoption. Operating margin 6.2%; operating cash flow $290M. #earnings #software

$CAPL Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +23% Y/Y driven by higher fuel prices, while gross profit fell 3% as costs grew faster than sales. Operating margin 2.0%; operating cash flow $24M. #earnings #industrials
$WES Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +25% Y/Y, driven by fee-based midstream services and recent acquisitions. Operating margin 38.6%; net earnings $332M. #earnings #utilities
$EVR EVR Q3 2026: $1.2B of revenue, +12% Y/Y. Net earnings $161M on a 20.7% operating margin. Charts + what drove it. Which would you look at first? #earnings #finance
